content: The stacked classifier is also tested against the results reported for four other algorithms BIBREF16, BIBREF26, BIBREF24, BIBREF15. All the comparisons are done using the NCHLT BIBREF7, DSL 2015 BIBREF19 and DSL 2017 BIBREF1 datasets discussed in Section SECREF2.
